acquisition_epoch: 2001 multiday composite, released 2002; not simulated epoch or live weather
transform: Process each checked 21600 x 21600 L hemisphere separately with Pillow BOX area resampling to 4096 x 4096; concatenate W then E into 8192 x 4096. Reduce that map to 4096 x 2048 with BOX. Encode lossless WebP. Coverage changes are limited to area averaging. No full native global mosaic, sharpening, inpainting, or synthetic cloud detail.

processing.peak_native_decode: One 21600 x 21600 L hemisphere at a time, about 445 MiB; never both native hemispheres or a full native RGBA mosaic
processing.temporary_runtime_canvas: No runtime conversion added; current TextureLoader decodes the global map as RGB/RGBA

8k.encoding: lossless WebP; achromatic RGB decode of one grayscale coverage channel
8k.gpu_format: RGBA8 with the existing TextureLoader; sampled as NoColorSpace coverage
8k.packing_note: One coverage value is repeated in RGB; runtime samples red. No R8 conversion is claimed for the current global loader.

validation.comparison: Complete decoded image compared with the BOX-reduced L image before encoding

4k.encoding: lossless WebP; achromatic RGB decode of one grayscale coverage channel
4k.gpu_format: RGBA8 with the existing TextureLoader; sampled as NoColorSpace coverage
4k.packing_note: One coverage value is repeated in RGB; runtime samples red. No R8 conversion is claimed for the current global loader.

validation.comparison: Complete decoded image compared with the BOX-reduced L image before encoding

limits: Static display coverage from the same 2001 NASA composite as the native tiles; not simulated-date weather, cloud-water, radiance, RF loss, or a thermal input.
Downsampling removes spatial detail. Blank source coverage, polar gaps, mosaic boundaries and other source artifacts remain; absent coverage is not filled.

Matching the source prevents camera LOD changes from switching between different cloud composites. Native lossy WebP tiles and the area-reduced global map can still differ at the pixel and filtering scale.
Original Solar System Scope cloud maps remain bundled as legacy assets with their original provenance and license.
